# Inner Light Juice

> Inner Light Juice is an organic, plant-based juice bar with two locations in Colorado's Vail Valley: Eagle and Edwards. We serve cold-pressed juice, superfood smoothies, smoothie bowls, wellness shots, housemade nut milks, lemonades, organic coffee and matcha, salads and raw desserts. The whole menu is 100% organic, plant-based, gluten-free, dairy-free and refined-sugar-free. Juices come in returnable glass.

## Locations
- [Eagle](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/locations/eagle): 115 E 2nd St, Eagle, CO 81631 (corner of 2nd & Broadway). Open daily 8am–4pm. (970) 705-4188.
- [Edwards](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/locations/edwards): 225 Main St, Unit C106e, Edwards, CO 81632 (Riverwalk at Edwards). Mon–Sat 9am–4pm, Sun 10am–3pm. (970) 914-2499.

## Key pages
- [Menu](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/menu): full menu with ingredients and prices.
- [Order online](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/order): order ahead for pickup at either store.
- [Juice cleanse](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/cleanse): Awaken, Radiate and Rise cleanse packages, with preparation guidance.
- [Glass return program](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/sustainability): $0.50 credit per 12 oz bottle or 16 oz jar, $0.25 per 2 oz bottle.
- [Our story](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/journey): founded in 2021 by Vail Valley locals; began as a food truck.
- [Contact](https://www.innerlightjuice.com/connect): team@innerlightjuice.com
